goal: A validated skill-creator draft can be enabled for Agent execution on a chosen project without auto-enabling unvalidated drafts or other projects
scenarios: validating a draft does not register it for agent execution
a validated draft can be enabled for a project and used on an agent run
an unvalidated draft still cannot be enabled
enabling for one project does not enable it for another project
enabling one draft does not enable other drafts
enabled skill-creator versions are retained in history
constraints: technology skill packs are out of scope
do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
